What a swimmer runs into on the current page
  • “Limited lanes”, but never how many. 2 of the 5 is our estimate.
  • The fall hours run “September 8 – November 13” and the maintenance closure “November 13 – December 25”.
  • December 31 is listed as closed and as a half day, 1–5pm. “MLKD/Juneteenth (January 19)” puts two holidays on one wrong date.
